stem: In a child with possible chronic diarrhoea, which additional growth parameter should also be reviewed to help distinguish gastrointestinal-related loss from other causes?
explanation: Head circumference should also be reviewed. It helps interpret the pattern of growth and can distinguish gastrointestinal-related loss from other causes.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Correct because head circumference is an important additional growth measure and can help interpret the pattern of growth.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because weight-for-length does not replace reviewing head circumference in this context.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because repeating weight alone does not provide the broader growth pattern needed.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because height alone is insufficient without also considering head circumference.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because mid-upper arm circumference is not the key additional parameter being asked for here.
